> Suraksha Whispering Waves is a residential apartment project by R K Suraksha Properties,
> located adjacent to the 137-acre Begur Lake in South Bengaluru, Karnataka, India.
> The project offers 2 BHK, 3 BHK and 4 BHK homes across six towers (A through F),
> with curated lifestyle amenities and Club Élan, a six-level lifestyle clubhouse.
> RERA registration number: PRM/KA/RERA/1251/310/PR/270326/008555 (valid till 31-12-2030).
